name: Dr. Leslie Wells
roles: Speaker, author, energy-medicine facilitator, radio host, and founder of Faith Consciousness.
short: Dr. Leslie Wells is a Doctor of Chiropractic whose two decades of practice grew from the spine into the spirit. She is the founder of Faith Consciousness, a teaching that bridges scripture, neuroscience, and the quantum field, and the host of Faith Consciousness Radio on WSIC.
